title: mailproof.net
tagline: Anti phishing / blockchain proof. MAIL Proof – Verify with AI, Secured by Chain
description:
MAIL Proof is your personal AI agent for email and document trust.
Phishing attempts, spoofed senders, suspicious payment requests? Simply forward any questionable email to check@mailproof.net.

Our AI instantly analyzes the sender (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), inspects links, content, and attachments.
Within seconds, you receive a clear, actionable trust report:
Verified as safe
Suspicious (e.g. shortened links, unknown domains, missing authentication)
Likely phishing, with detailed evidence and advice.
But we go further.
If you need to verify a file, just send it to file@mailproof.net. You’ll receive:
A secure cryptographic hash
A proof-of-deposit linked to your email address
A one-click link to certify the file on the blockchain (Hedera, Word ID integration).

Our mission is to make digital trust as simple as forwarding an email.
No apps. No setup. No friction.
With pay-per-use, subscriptions, and crypto-friendly options, MAIL Proof is ready for everyone.

It’s anti-phishing for all.
Blockchain-backed proof, without complexity.
Your universal trust layer for emails and files.

Kill the phish. Keep the proof.
how_its_made:
Email Verification
NLP-based email analysis powered by Vlayer
Automated AI-generated trust report
Sender authentication via Word ID (World.org)

File Certification
File fingerprinting with SHA-256 hash
Certification on Hedera or any EVM-compatible L2
Public proof visualization through Blockscout

Crypto Payments
One-time activation required
Payment routing via 1inch aggregator
Supports stablecoins, ETH, and multiple tokens
AI Orchestration (via Vlayer)

AI pipeline includes:
Email parsing
Attachment analysis
Threat reranking
Signature generation and validation
